answer: In the protocol each validator deposits stake C and is subject to a superlinear slashing matrix S_{ij}=k(C_i C_j)^a (a>1) so coalition loss scales faster than combined capital. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay ties epoch finality to a crystal commitment; any deviation emits a whisper proof that forces the adversary to endure tide of escalating penalties before finalization. The resulting adversary utility U = sum p*R - sum (1-p)*S_{ij} is provably negative for all rational strategies, yielding a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium immune to Sybil attacks.
